record.paper_title: Some Open Problems in the Theory of Computation as Questions about Two-Way Deterministic Pushdown Automaton Languages
record.original_question: What exact inclusion or equality relationship holds between 2NC, the class of two-way nondeterministic counter-machine languages, and DLOG, the class of deterministic logarithmic-space languages?

evidence.quote: 4. What is the relationship between 2NC and DLOG?

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Let 2NC denote the class of languages recognized by two-way nondeterministic counter machines. Such a machine is a finite-state device equipped with a two-way read-only input head (with input endmarkers) and a finite number of counters, each holding a nonnegative integer that can be incremented, decremented, and tested for zero; the machine accepts nondeterministically. Let DLOG denote the class of languages decidable by a deterministic Turing machine using O(log n) work-tape space on inputs of length n.

Determine the exact relationship between the classes 2NC and DLOG. Specifically, decide which of the following holds, and prove it:
(a) 2NC ⊊ DLOG,
(b) DLOG ⊊ 2NC,
(c) 2NC = DLOG, or
(d) 2NC and DLOG are incomparable under set inclusion.
artifact.status_search_result: No source establishes a definitive equality or strict inclusion between the class of two-way nondeterministic counter-machine languages and DLOG. The question is closely tied to longstanding open problems separating deterministic from nondeterministic logspace, and existing literature on two-way (weak) counter machines and nondeterministic counter languages does not resolve it.

status_evidence.title: Remarks on the complexity of nondeterministic counter languages
status_evidence.snippet: Studies complexity of nondeterministic counter languages and their relation to logspace classes.
status_evidence.claim: Connects counter-machine language classes to logarithmic-space complexity, without resolving 2NC vs DLOG.

status_evidence.title: On two-way weak counter machines
status_evidence.snippet: Establishes hierarchies for two-way nondeterministic counter machines based on the number of counters.
status_evidence.claim: Shows structural results about two-way counter machines but does not equate or separate 2NC from DLOG.
